cohort: Patients who underwent cesarean section in 5 Polish hospitals during 2013-2015
finding: The incidence of SSI after cesarean section was low (0.5%) but varied significantly between hospitals and by ASA score and SSI risk index, with a significantly higher risk observed in procedures without antibiotic prophylaxis.
mod_finding: The study investigated surgical site infection (SSI) risk factors after Caesarean sections (CS) but did not specifically examine different modes of delivery.
